profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have over 14  years of experience building software. I’ve worked with different languages and frameworks, on both front and back end. My current specialty is large scale single page applications written in react. 
I’ve worked in different industries including gaming, hospitality, and e-commerce. 
I’ve worked as  a contributor on small and large teams, as well as a leader of teams composed of local developers and offshore contributors.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · React.js · Node.js · GraphQL · Prisma

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote
positions.description: At Shopify I was part of the Marketplaces team. Our goal was to help 3rd party partners, like google, meta, and Spotify, integrate with our systems. I contributed to building APIs that enabled Shopify products to be listed on spotify, google, youtube, facebook and instagram. We used rails, go, react and node in our tech stack.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Ruby on Rails · GraphQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: At Podium I was part of the core frontend development team responsible for the performance and reliability of our application. I was also responsible for establishing and maintaining code patterns and practices. We used elixir and react in our tech stack.

positions.title: Senior Associate Experience Technology L2
positions.description: At Publicis Sapient I lead the frontend development team for one of the largest gaming companies in Las Vegas. I worked on the hotel booking and entertainment e-commerce systems. Our tech stack was Adobe Experience Manager, Java, react and angular.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description: At Overstock I built and maintained multiple customer facing and internal applications. One of the biggest projects I led was an AI powered chatbot built with Google’s Dialogflow and Salesforce chat apis, with a custom react front end. Our tech stack included salesforce apex, java, node and react.

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description: At iCentris I worked on a large team building and maintaining applications used by many well known MLMs with thousands of users. We used a custom ruby on rails and react tech stack.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Ruby on Rails · Redux

positions.title: Developer & Marketing Specialist
positions.description: At Pinnacle I worked with a small development team on various applications. We managed a custom application for end users to view and manage their gaming offers as well as a custom CMS for our websites which we then migrated to a large enterprise CMS provider. I also lead the email marketing team, building and deploying hundreds of marketing campaigns per month.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Managed a ruby on rails applications for a small company. Was responsible for front and back end development and maintenance while working under a senior developer.
